en-US.name: MemoryLane
en-US.summary: Your family trips as a slideshow on the Echo Show.
en-US.description: Play any trip from your MemoryLane household on an Echo Show. Say "Alexa, ask Memory Lane to play the latest trip" or name a trip. Devices without a screen hear the trip's story instead.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Memory Lane to play the latest trip
Alexa, ask Memory Lane to show Skye

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Link an Amazon account that has signed in a MemoryLane TV. Say "play the latest trip" on an Echo Show.
